name: Patriot 1 TAA Replacement Lace Set (Black)
title: Patriot 1 TAA Replacement Lace Set (Black)
description_en:
Built as a direct replacement for the original Patriot 1 speed lace system, this kit includes everything needed to quickly restore fit, function, and performance without replacing the entire boot. Whether your laces have worn out from hard use, repeated field work, training cycles, or daily duty wear, this replacement kit gets you back up and running fast.

Designed to mirror the original quick-lace configuration, the kit includes precut replacement laces, lace keeper, and rubber pull tab for a secure fit and rapid adjustment on the move. The system allows for fast tightening, reliable tension retention, and easy stowing of excess lace in the boot’s lace pocket.

name: Men's Defender 1 (Black Multicam)
title: Men's Defender 1 (Black Multicam)
description_en:
The Duty Boot For Athletes. 

The Defender 1 is built on the Savage 1 platform, which means it's engineered to sprint, climb, kneel, lift, brace, and change direction- everything you do on the job. Too many duty boots lack the flexibility and function you require to move like an athlete. So we took the Savage 1 DNA and made it ready for duty. Unlike your standard-issued boots, each Defender 1 weighs in at less than a pound. Our signature wide toe box, 4mm drop, lightweight EVA midsole and TPU heel stabilizer balance stability with all-day comfort so your feet aren't aching by the end of your shift. With its polished suede and polyester upper, the Defender 1 meets uniform requirements without sacrificing athletic performance. The job demands a lot from you, and the duty boots you've been issued aren't made to move the way you need them to. Until now.

Due to the natural variation of the Black Multicam camouflage pattern, exact pattern placement will vary on every pair. As a result, each shoe features a unique layout and will differ from pair to pair.

name: Gadsden Flag Tee (Black)
title: Gadsden Flag Tee (Black)
description_en: Dating back to the Revolutionary War period when it was originally referenced by Benjamin Franklin as the symbol of American spirit, this flag represented the American defiance as we fought for our independence. Today, the Gadsden symbol is still worn as an official patch on the left shoulder of naval uniforms, and it pays homage to our forefathers who were bold and daring enough to fight for their independence and establish the freedoms we enjoy today. As a veteran-owned company, this symbol holds significance for our brand. And we’re proud to have the symbol of the American spirit displayed on one of our most-loved t-shirt designs.

Colonel Christopher Gadsden of the Continental Marines brought this flag out on the water for our country's first naval mission and presented it to the Commodore of the Navy to fly in the formation. Today, the Gadsden symbol is still worn as an official patch on the left shoulder of naval uniforms, and it pays homage to our forefathers who were bold and daring enough to fight for their independence and establish the freedoms we enjoy today. Order this Gadsden flag shirt for yourself.

name: Men's Frontier Pant 2.0 (Coyote Brown)
title: Men's Frontier Pant 2.0 (Coyote Brown)
description_en:
Heavyweight, functional, and durable backcountry trousers.  Versatility ranges from warm climates to extreme cold when paired with our layering system.

The Frontier 2.0, is the perfect combination of function, fit, and durability. Engineered from fabric that is flexible enough to move without hindrance and durable enough to stand up to anything you may encounter in the field.  Featuring a warm but breathable 4-way stretch fabric with side zip vents, internal knee pad pockets, a water-repellent finish, reinforcements on the knees, seat, and heel, a truly versatile pocket system,  and a dialed-in athletic fit for unrestricted mobility.

Conditions: 60°F to Frigid

description_en:
The Athlete’s Barefoot Shoe.

The Primitive 1 was built on one simple belief: stronger feet build stronger athletes.

The Primitive 1 embraces the principles of natural movement with a zero-drop platform, wide toe box, and removable footbed that encourage natural foot mechanics and a stronger connection to the ground. Purposefully designed for athletes, a reinforced heel clip provides the stability and confidence needed for heavy lifts, explosive movement, and high-intensity training, creating a shoe that combines barefoot principles with the stability athletes demand.

Every detail was engineered to help athletes train closer to the ground without sacrificing the stability to perform at their best.

name: Men's Urban Recon 1 (Black)
title: Men's Urban Recon 1 (Black)
description_en:
Classic Look, Built Wider.

Traditional street shoes look great, but are built narrow with minimal cushioning. After a day of wear, your toes, heels, and arches ache. Our CEO, Bear, had the same problem. He loved the look of popular skate shoes, but his feet would hurt after wearing them all day. So he decided to take what we’ve learned from the Savage 1 and apply it to a casual shoe you can comfortably wear all day. Meet the Urban Recon 1, the street shoe built for all-day comfort and functionality.

Constructed with Born Primitive’s signature wide toe box, lightweight EVA midsole, and removable dual-density molded footbed, the Urban Recon 1 delivers comfort and support where traditional street shoes fail. When it comes to your toes, millimeters matter. The Urban Recon 1's toe box is 8mm wider than the leading skate shoe and holds over 18% more volume. If you’re tired of smashing your toes into a narrow toe box for the sake of style, it’s time to try the Urban Recon 1.

Also, please note that although the product's hang tags state TAA, the product isn't TAA-compliant because the size printed inside the garment is incorrect which revokes its TAA classification. 

Additionally, there may be minor irregularities in the garment that are not easily noticeable to the average customer, but they fall short of our strict quality standards.

Because of these issues, we are offering these pants at a special price of $150.


The Op Assault Pant combines durability, mobility, and functionality to meet the demands of any mission. Constructed with abrasion-resistant stretch fabric and reinforced with extra stretch panels at the back yoke and knees, these pants deliver unmatched flexibility and comfort.

A reinforced two-ply seat enhances durability in high-wear areas, while adjustable hook-and-loop waist tabs and oversized belt loops ensure a secure, customizable fit. Designed for practicality, these pants feature multiple pockets for optimal organization and quick access to mission-essential gear.

Proudly Made With US Fabrics

Assembled in Nicaragua

name: Sun Shirt w/ Velcro 2.0 (Multicam)
title: Sun Shirt w/ Velcro 2.0 (Multicam)
description_en:
The Sun Shirt 2.0 is designed for high-performance wear in the hottest conditions, providing superior sun protection and comfort during extended exposure to the elements. 

Constructed from a lightweight, quick-drying fabric, this shirt keeps you cool and dry throughout the day, even in sweltering temperatures.  Featuring UPF 30 Block Technology, the Sun Shirt 2.0 shields your skin from harmful UV rays while allowing for optimal breathability. An integrated face mask is built into the hood for increased coverage and added protection against sun, wind, or dust.  The oversized hood offers extra coverage for your head and neck, while extended sleeves with thumbholes provide additional protection for your hands and wrists. With a loose, airy fit for maximum airflow, this shirt ensures you stay cool and comfortable during long days in the sun.

name: Sun Shirt 2.0 (Coyote Brown)
title: Sun Shirt 2.0 (Coyote Brown)
description_en:
The Sun Shirt 2.0 is designed for high-performance wear in the hottest conditions, providing superior sun protection and comfort during extended exposure to the elements. 

Constructed from a lightweight, quick-drying fabric, this shirt keeps you cool and dry throughout the day, even in sweltering temperatures.  Featuring UPF 30 Block Technology, the Sun Shirt 2.0 shields your skin from harmful UV rays while allowing for optimal breathability. An integrated face mask is built into the hood for increased coverage and added protection against sun, wind, or dust.  The oversized hood offers extra coverage for your head and neck, while extended sleeves with thumbholes provide additional protection for your hands and wrists. With a loose, airy fit for maximum airflow, this shirt ensures you stay cool and comfortable during long days in the sun.

name: Gadsden Flag Crop Tee (Black)
title: Gadsden Flag Crop Tee (Black)
description_en: Dating back to the Revolutionary War period when it was originally referenced by Benjamin Franklin as the symbol of American spirit, this flag represented the American defiance as we fought for our independence. Today, the Gadsden symbol is still worn as an official patch on the left shoulder of naval uniforms, and it pays homage to our forefathers who were bold and daring enough to fight for their independence and establish the freedoms we enjoy today. As a veteran-owned company, this symbol holds significance for our brand. And we’re proud to have the symbol of the American spirit displayed on one of our most-loved cropped t-shirt designs.

name: Women's Frontier Pant 2.0 (Coyote Brown)
title: Women's Frontier Pant 2.0 (Coyote Brown)
description_en:
Heavyweight, functional, and durable backcountry pants. Versatility ranges from warm climates to extreme cold when paired with our layering system. 

The Women's Frontier 2.0 is the perfect combination of function, fit, and durability, designed specifically with a female cut. Engineered from fabric that is flexible enough to move without hindrance and durable enough to withstand any challenge in the field. Featuring a warm but breathable 4-way stretch fabric with side zip vents, internal knee pad pockets, a water-repellent finish, reinforcements on the knees, seat, and heel, a versatile pocket system, and a dialed-in athletic fit that accommodates the female form for unrestricted mobility. 

These pants are offered in 3 inseams-- Short 29", Regular 32" and Tall 35".

*If you are using these pants as a layering piece or you are between sizes, we recommend sizing up.*

The Primitive 1 was built on one simple belief: stronger feet build stronger athletes.

The Primitive 1 embraces the principles of natural movement with a zero-drop platform, wide toe box, and removable footbed that encourage natural foot mechanics and a stronger connection to the ground. Every detail was engineered to help athletes train closer to the ground without sacrificing the stability to perform at their best.
